d: In this episode of Rajdoot, Hosted by Nikhil, Written by Sajid, we look at Pakistan’s growing space partnership with China as Pakistani Air Force Wing Commander Muhammad Zeeshan Ali becomes the first foreign astronaut to join a Chinese space mission. We explore how Zeeshan was selected and trained, why he had to learn Mandarin, and what experiments he will conduct aboard China’s Tiangong Space Station.
